title: MONAI Label open-source AI medical imaging: CISA added CVE-2026-133968 (CVSS 9.8) to KEV on 23 November
content_md:
MONAI Label (imaging medico con AI, open source): CISA l'ha messa nel KEV il 23/11: CVE-2026-133968, CVSS 9.8. Path traversal negli endpoint

via Mastodon https://github.com/Project-MONAI/MONAILabel/security/advisories/GHSA-qc22-rmgc-vg94

CVE-2026-133968.evidence: Post states CISA placed the CVSS 9.8 MONAI Label path traversal flaw in KEV on 23/11, confirming active exploitation.
